coordinatesConvention: Absolute original asset pixels. Rectangles are x,y,width,height; centers are x,y.
prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied transparent game UI frame only. Remove ALL decorative water bubbles from both inside and around the panel, remove the small green seaweed at bottom-left, and remove any decorative particles or outside glow. Remove the fixed central bottom triangular speech pointer by restoring a straight continuous horizontal gold bottom border at the same y position as the rest of the bottom border. The main body must now be a rounded rectangle with smooth straight edges, no pointer or notch. PRESERVE unchanged: image size 1368x1149, raised blank large rounded title pill and its position, exact glossy cyan/teal caustic interior, gold double border and white/cyan highlights, orange food orb at (190,402), XP star around (188,533), empty growth track x121..1246 y593..660, and exactly FIVE neutral hollow circular stage markers at (204,718),(441,718),(684,718),(924,718),(1161,718). These five stage markers are functional icons: retain them, they are NOT decorative bubbles. Keep ONLY existing letters XP on the star, add no text, no fish, no background. Restore seamless turquoise panel shading where seaweed/bubbles were removed. Transparent RGBA alpha outside the panel and title pill. No checkerboard, no matte background. Goal is the same polished asset with clean unadorned edges and a flat bottom rim, everything else unchanged.

Make this a transparent PNG asset. Delete the entire gray checkered background around the outside of the UI frame, with clean anti-aliased edges and real alpha transparency. Keep all of the teal cyan and gold UI frame, XP star, orange orb, progress bar, and five circular stage markers. Keep the colored panel interior filled. Preserve the exact current teal cyan palette, feature positions, and dimensions. The background must be transparent, not a drawing of a transparency checkerboard. This is a background removal task only. No extra decorations, bubbles, seaweed, particles, glow, or pointer.

validation.removed: All decorative water bubbles, seaweed, particles, outside glow, and fixed speech pointer removed. Bottom gold border is now a straight horizontal edge with rounded corners.
validation.retained: Raised blank header pill, gold double border, glossy cyan/teal caustic interior, orange food orb, XP star, empty growth track, five neutral hollow circular stage markers.
validation.text: Only XP remains on star; no other text or fish.
validation.alpha: True RGBA transparency outside. Small very low-alpha fringe from imagegen remains around the border; alpha >8 bounds measured above.
validation.deviations: Minor feature shifts up to approximately four pixels relative to previous frame; rings retain bright silver/cyan bevel. No code, test, or original asset changes.
